title: Typesetting a document
text: ordinary LaTeX, appear \begin{document} \end{document}: max_width text width big points (1/72 inch):
code: body <- r"(\section{Methods} We fit a straight line to $n$ observations $(x_i, y_i)$ by least squares, which chooses the intercept and slope that minimise the sum of squared residuals \[ S(\beta_0, \beta_1) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} (y_i - \beta_0 - \beta_1 x_i)^2. \] Setting both partial derivatives to zero gives the estimates \begin{align*}   \hat\beta_1 &= \frac{\sum_i (x_i - \bar x)(y_i - \bar y)}{\sum_i (x_i - \bar x)^2}, \\   \hat\beta_0 &= \bar y - \hat\beta_1 \bar x. \end{align*}  The fitted values are $\hat y_i = \hat\beta_0 + \hat\beta_1 x_i$, and the residuals $e_i = y_i - \hat y_i$ are what is left over.  \subsection{Assumptions} The errors are taken to be \begin{itemize}   \item independent of one another,   \item of constant variance $\sigma^2$, and   \item normally distributed --- which matters only for the tests. \end{itemize} )" grid.newpage() grid.latex(body, input_mode = "document", max_width = 5.6 * 72,            x = 0.03, y = 0.97, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,            gp = gpar(fontsize = 11))

title: gridmicrotex 0.2.0
text: LaTeX read new, faster parser follows TeX’s rules, macros, environments starred forms work LaTeX, malformed input drawn warning giving line:col instead failing. TeX, space command dropped (write \LaTeX{} ), _, ^, # & outside math warn. New input_mode = "document" renders LaTeX document body, whole pasted paper, wrapped max_width (see vignette("documents")). Markdown now laid way, paragraphs, styled spans tables stay within box. New latex_options(device_math = TRUE) renders $…$ math base graphics labels. image drawn now error saying , figures load ten times faster, many bugs fixed.

title: gridmicrotex 0.1.1
text: CRAN release: 2026-08-24 typeface fallback now message rather warning, raised render_mode = "typeface" actually asked , per device. figure holding many math labels longer repeats . Bug fix: layout engine’s macro tables never freed. leaked process exit, unloadNamespace() left shared object place. now released.

title: gridmicrotex 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-08-21 Text inside \text{} drawn line time rather letter time, kerning applied, PDF/SVG output can searched phrase, files several times smaller. Text given max_width drawn word time, since spaces breaks. Right--left text renders correct order, including across emphasis, colour font changes, without max_width. New markdown_grob() grid.markdown() render inline markdown LaTeX math; markdown_box_grob() renders block document. New geom_markdown() element_markdown() ggplot2, taking style. title containing headings lists laid blocks, flattened. Markdown covers headings, lists, task lists, quotes, code, tables, images, footnotes, display $$…$$, links inline HTML. fenced code block keeps indentation syntax-highlighted names language. New register_highlighter() available_highlighters(). R, Python, SQL, shell, C++, YAML, JSON, Stan, Julia LaTeX built , along usual GitHub aliases; token colours CSS classes (.kw, .co, .st, …), names knitr already writes HTML output. Grammars KDE syntax XML files. New markdown_style() md_style() style markdown CSS cascade HTML tag names; body rule styles box . New latex_options(markdown_style = ) sets document-wide default. New "github" style preset, shipped CSS file. <div class=> <div style=> style chunk markdown; <span class=> styles inline run. New justify line_break arguments control paragraph line breaking. New \gmfontfamily{family}{content} sets font one run text. \includegraphics[width=,height=,scale=,keepaspectratio]{file} draws PNG, JPEG SVG images inline formula; previously parsed drew nothing. extension may omitted \graphicspath{} searched, LaTeX. SVG drawn real vector, stays sharp output resolution. New p{len} column type gives tabular fixed-width, wrapping cells. \url{} \href{}{} render styled text instead literally. load_font() renamed load_math_font(); old name deprecated. check_fonts() renamed check_math_fonts(); old name deprecated. Bug fix: \rotatebox past quarter turn drew text glyphs 180 degrees , \rotatebox{90} label came upside . Bug fix: \textrm{} now returns text gp$fontfamily; previously nothing. Bug fix: \texttt{} drew body font instead monospace one. Bug fix: max_width now honoured content containing \\ line breaks. Bug fix: "mixed" mode line break kept inside text rather breaking formula, anything drawn beside whole block instead line. pasted \caption landed left table, math following line break sat lines. Bug fix: LaTeX tick labels measured 0 x 0, ggplot2 reserved room overlapped axis title. Bug fix: reloading package corrupted MicroTeX’s macro registry, later large formula crash R. Bug fix: \- offered line break drew hyphen . Bug fix: & text read alignment tab everything dropped, "Treatment & Control" rendered "Treatment ". Bug fix: tabular* failed parse, reporting invalid alignment; width argument now dropped along star. Bug fix: layout measured one graphics device reused another, placing text wrong widths — layout cache now keys device. Bug fix: package failed compile compilers longer declare strtod() strtol() headers, clang 23.

title: gridmicrotex 0.0.5
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-21 Bug fix: correct grobX()/grobY() boundary points. Bug fix: geom_latex(fontsize = ) ignored. Bug fix: spurious “font metrics unknown” warnings "mixed" mode. Bug fix: CJK fallback width Windows ~6x narrow. Bug fix: layout-cache collisions unresolved text fonts. Bug fix: measuring \text{} runs longer pushes viewport caller’s device. push/pop recorded graphics engine display list, device looked like already held plot knitr emitted spurious blank figure ahead real one. Hardened OTF MATH reader malformed fonts hang R. Docs: input_mode defaults "mixed"; use \textbf{} etc. instead gp$fontface.

title: gridmicrotex 0.0.4
text: CRAN release: 2026-06-01 Accept raw latex code packages, like xtable::print.xtable() / knitr::kable() / booktabs output. New MicroTeX commands \thickhline \cline{-b}. New itemize enumerate list environments. Lists may nest. Bug fix: $…$ inside tabular cells longer chops table. Bug fix: starred alignment envs (align*, eqnarray*, …) now render. Bug fix: latex_wrap() now vectorised input, matching documented contract, errors NA input instead rendering “NA”. Bug fix: \mark{} macro survives microtex_release() / re-init cycle. gp$col transparency now honoured (alpha passed MicroTeX). Macro expansion warns circular definitions instead silently producing wrong output.
